info.title: Adyuta AI API
info.description: API for predictions, embeddings, and retrieval

get.summary: Honesty ledger: AI/ML vs deterministic, multilingual tiers, model provenance
get.description: Returns the complete honesty ledger of ADYUTA capabilities. Distinguishes learned AI/ML models from deterministic rule-based modules, provides exact multilingual capability tiers (refuting flat 13-language claims), details model provenance, and explicitly marks non-canonical research artifacts as non-production.

schema.title: Response Get Chunks Retrieval Get Post

get.summary: Project-wide numbers, read from existing artifacts only
get.description: One call for the headline corpus/vector-store, crop-disease, market and LLM-benchmark numbers. Every value is read from an on-disk artifact; sections whose artifacts are missing come back as null with a warning.

Stage 5C validation and manifest numbers: vector count, dimension/normalisation/id-match checks, metadata coverage and domain coverage. Artifact-only, so no vector store is opened and no embedding model is loaded.

get.summary: Local-LLM benchmark scores, plus any hand-audited safety findings
get.description: Per-candidate scores from the isolated local-LLM benchmark, question-set composition, and every hand-audited safety flag found in the audit artifacts (including the carbendazim dosing failure) with the verbatim audit note and model answer as evidence.

post.description:
Stage 5E-C: retrieval → selection → generation in one call.

Validation mirrors /prepare (query 1-2000, top_k 1-50). Empty retrieval is
answered from clearly-labelled general knowledge for supported domains
(retrieval_info.general_knowledge_fallback=True plus the 'Adyuta can make
mistakes with LLM generated answers' warning in the answer text);
out-of-scope queries still get a grounded abstention and never call the
LLM, and safety always returns its static answer without generating.
Optional `session_id` / `history` add lightweight multi-turn context; the
`/rag/prepare` contract is deliberately left unchanged.

post.summary: Detect crop disease from uploaded leaf image
post.description: Analyzes an uploaded leaf image using a lightweight MobileNetV3 TFLite model trained on 38 PlantVillage disease categories. Returns disease identification, confidence, health status, and actionable offline agronomic advice.

post.summary: Deterministic symptom triage and health advisory
post.description: Accepts free-text symptoms (en/kn/hi/ta), runs deterministic rule-based triage (urgent → primary → self_care → abstain), and returns an actionable advisory. Not a learned model and not a diagnosis. Optionally augments with RAG-retrieved health context when online.

get.description: Deterministic lookup over first-aid topics transcribed from the health corpus: bleeding and wounds, minor burns, snakebite, dehydration, diarrhoea/ORS, heat exhaustion and heat stroke. No model generates or rephrases the steps; every entry names the document it came from.

post.summary: Get next-day potato modal price prediction for a mandi
post.description: Returns the persistence baseline (last observed price) by default. Optional model_version parameter allows Ridge level/delta models for comparison. Series with insufficient history (<30 obs or <20% coverage) are refused with the last price shown.

get.description: Returns schemes from the transcribed catalogue. With `q`, ranks by keyword/name/token overlap. Entries whose source document records no detail set `details_available=false` and return empty benefit lists instead of plausible figures.

get.summary: One grievance, including its status history

get.description: Returns lessons from the transcribed catalogue, ordered by keyword/name/token overlap when `q` is supplied. Text is intended to be spoken by the device, not the server.

get.summary: Static safety advisories (rule-based; no generation, ever)
get.description: Returns pre-written advisories for a hazard, optionally filtered by free-text query. `state` and `district` are accepted but reported honestly: the corpus is national, so `region_matched` stays false and `location_note` says why. No LLM is invoked on this path.

National and thematic helplines transcribed from the corpus. `state` returns the source document's state examples when they exist and explicitly reports when they do not. No LLM is invoked on this path.

GroundingInfo.title: GroundingInfo
GroundingInfo.description:
How much retrieved evidence the answer actually rests on.

A domain whose entire corpus is one chunk can only produce thin grounding.
Reporting it lets a caller treat the answer as a pointer to the source rather
than as a complete answer.
